actions.description:
Requirements A creature is Grabbed or Restrained by the interrogator

Effect One creature grabbed or restrained by the interrogator takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] save. If the creature fails its save, it also gains a condition of the interrogator's choice: Clumsy 2 for 1 minute, Enfeebled 2 for 1 minute, or Drained 1.
actions.name: Hobble
actions.requirements: A creature is Grabbed or Restrained by the interrogator

actions.description:
The interrogator Strikes with a slashing melee weapon. If they hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent bleed damage and is Frightened 1 (or 2d4 persistent bleed damage and Frightened 2 on a critical hit).

Each of the interrogator's other enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] around the target that witnesses the bloodshed must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:19|traits:emotion,fear,mental,visual] save or be frightened 1. The frightened part of this ability is an emotion, fear, mental, and visual effect.
actions.name: Blood and Fear

actions.description: The interrogator's Strikes deal an additional 1d8 mental damage to Frightened creatures.
actions.name: Torment

name: Interrogator
publicNotes:
Interrogators use pain and intimidation against prisoners and other helpless victims to force "confessions."

Villains pursue selfish and cruel goals, trampling over anyone in their way.
